tool_args.old_string:
\textbf{Low-dose ISR ($\beta{=}0.1$): ISR-specific gaming.}
The most striking number at 500 steps is H7: 69.7\% of proved samples under ISR ($n{=}161/231$) vs.\ \emph{zero} under random ($0/256$); however, extended training to 1000 steps reveals random $\beta{=}0.1$ converges to $100\%$ H7 (seed~42), indicating ISR accelerates H7 onset rather than being its sole cause. %% registry: plan002 vs plan018 all seeds
H7---a single premise identical to the conclusion, giving $\text{ISR}\geq 0.5$ by construction (\S\ref{sec:taxonomy-method})---is the canonical meta-level Goodhart move: the model satisfies the LOO definition directly rather than producing a derivation that happens to satisfy it.
Total conclusion embedding ($\text{H1}+\text{H7}$) is GRPO-universal at $68$--$100\%$ across both conditions, and is in fact \emph{higher} under random (pooled H1 81\% vs.\ 18\% under ISR).
ISR does not reduce hacking; it converts H1 into H7 (Figure~\ref{fig:hacking-composition}).
Random also yields higher and more stable PR ($85{\pm}6\%$ vs.\ $77{\pm}14\%$).
tool_args.new_string:
\textbf{Low-dose ISR ($\beta{=}0.1$): ISR-amplified gaming.}
H7 tautological collapse occurs under both ISR and random conditions, but ISR amplifies it ${\sim}5\times$: $70.6\%$ ($163/231$) under ISR vs.\ $13.7\%$ ($36/262$) under random (Fisher $p{=}1.3{\times}10^{-39}$, $\text{OR}{=}15.05$). %% registry: plan002 vs plan018 all seeds; D095 FINAL
Random H7 is highly seed-dependent: $38.3\%$ in seed~43 vs.\ $0\%$ in seeds~42 and~44; ISR makes H7 near-deterministic ($2/3$ seeds at $97$--$100\%$, Table~\ref{tab:fol-detailed}).
H7---a single premise identical to the conclusion, giving $\text{ISR}\geq 0.5$ by construction (\S\ref{sec:taxonomy-method})---is the canonical meta-level Goodhart move: the model satisfies the LOO definition directly rather than producing a derivation that happens to satisfy it.
Total conclusion embedding ($\text{H1}+\text{H7}$) is GRPO-universal at $68$--$100\%$ across both conditions, and is in fact \emph{higher} under random (pooled H1 $71\%$ vs.\ $18\%$ under ISR).
ISR does not reduce hacking; it converts H1 into H7 (Figure~\ref{fig:hacking-composition}).
Random also yields higher and more stable PR ($87{\pm}8\%$ vs.\ $77{\pm}14\%$).

tool_args.old_string:
After reclassifying premise-subset gaming (H8; Appendix~\ref{app:h8}) and correcting H7 classifier false negatives (s44, $n{=}12$; Appendix~\ref{app:h4}), ISR $\beta{=}0.1$ genuine rate is \emph{significantly lower} than random ($6.9\%$ vs.\ $18.4\%$; Fisher $p{=}0.0002$, two-sided; $n{=}231$ vs.\ $256$; Appendix Table~\ref{tab:bootstrap-ci}).
Even a conservative correction (H8 reclassification only, no FN fix) yields $p{=}0.060$---marginal but directionally consistent.
ISR-specific gaming modes (H7 + H8) crowd out genuine proofs: the structural signal provides no quality benefit and actively \emph{reduces} genuine output by creating optimization targets that are easier to satisfy than real derivations.
The raw $3.2\times$ ISR$^*$ headline collapses once the LOO bias is controlled---a methodological lesson for any LOO-based metric on variable-length outputs. %% artifact: wilson_ci_complete, h8_reclassification
tool_args.new_string:
After reclassifying premise-subset gaming (H8; Appendix~\ref{app:h8}) and correcting H7 classifier false negatives (s44, $n{=}12$; Appendix~\ref{app:h4}), ISR $\beta{=}0.1$ non-hacking rate ($6.1\%$, $14/231$) is numerically lower than random ($9.5\%$, $25/262$), but the difference is not statistically significant (Fisher $p{=}0.182$, two-sided, n.s.; Wilson 95\% CI: ISR $[3.6\%, 9.9\%]$, Random $[6.5\%, 13.7\%]$; Appendix Table~\ref{tab:bootstrap-ci}). %% D095 FINAL Fisher test
The key asymmetry is not in non-hacking rates but in gaming \emph{composition}: ISR converts stochastic H7 into near-deterministic convergence ($2/3$ seeds ${\geq}97\%$), while random H7 remains seed-dependent and H1-dominated.
The raw $3.2\times$ ISR$^*$ headline collapses once the LOO bias is controlled---a methodological lesson for any LOO-based metric on variable-length outputs. %% artifact: wilson_ci_complete, h8_reclassification
